single_construction_review.retained_statement: The absolute-curvature theorem and asymmetric profile lift remain the sole construction. The moved scalar proposition states c1_second>=p_second and c2_second>=q_second almost everywhere, with uniqueness of the curvature-minimal pair up to a common affine summand.
single_construction_review.regularity: The explicit assumption of locally integrable DISTRIBUTIONAL second derivatives is retained. It excludes singular-curvature additions; zero distributional second derivative implies the difference is affine.

proof_link.scope: The pinned theorem proves the two scalar lower bounds and common-affine uniqueness, as well as a symmetric-tilt conclusion no longer asserted by this manuscript proposition. Projecting its scalar conclusions is sufficient.
proof_link.exact_profile_bridge: p=C1+A and q=C2+A, where A(z)=max(-s_minus,0)*z+max(-f(0),0). This follows from the shared curvature integrals, common slope shift and origin normalization. Hence p_second=P, q_second=N and the common-affine uniqueness transfers.
proof_link.formalization_limit: The displayed D-formula equality bridge remains a mathematical correspondence, not a newly added Lean lemma. The existing Lean variant label and absolute-curvature mapping scope retain that distinction.
